summary: Iteration 8: Complete testing of Invoice Enhancements (Stripe payments, Paid/Not Paid badges, manual payment recording, payment history), Dashboard Enhanced Stats (operational alerts row), Settings (No-Notes Escalation Threshold, Xero integration, Stripe status). All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (18/18 passed) ===
GET /api/invoices - returns list of invoices
GET /api/invoices/stats/summary - returns total, paid, unpaid, overdue counts + total_revenue, total_collected, total_outstanding
POST /api/invoices - creates invoice with line items and tax calculation (subtotal/tax/total verified)
GET /api/invoices/{id} - returns single invoice with line_items and payments array
POST /api/invoices/{id}/record-payment - records partial payment, payment_status changes to 'partial'
POST /api/invoices/{id}/record-payment - records remaining payment, payment_status changes to 'paid'
POST /api/invoices/{id}/pay - Stripe payment returns checkout URL
DELETE /api/invoices/{id} - deletes invoice
GET /api/settings/no-notes-threshold - returns default values when no setting exists
PUT /api/settings/no-notes-threshold - saves threshold with enabled=true, threshold_hours, escalate_to
POST /api/tickets/check-escalation - returns escalated count
PUT /api/settings/no-notes-threshold - disable threshold (cleanup)
GET /api/settings/xero - returns Xero settings with client_id, connected status
PUT /api/settings/xero - saves Xero credentials
GET /api/dashboard/enhanced-stats - returns all required fields (total_revenue, outstanding, no_notes_tickets, sla_breaches, low_stock_products, pending_purchase_orders)
GET /api/dashboard/enhanced-stats - all values are correct numeric types
GET /api/products - regression test passed
GET /api/purchase-orders - regression test passed
=== Frontend UI Tests (all passed) ===
Dashboard: All 6 operational alert cards visible (Revenue, Outstanding, No Notes, SLA Breaches, Low Stock, Pending POs)
Dashboard: Revenue card shows $0 collected
Dashboard: Outstanding card shows $0 / 0 unpaid
Dashboard: No Notes card shows 10 tickets without notes
Dashboard: SLA Breaches card shows 7 overdue tickets
Dashboard: Low Stock shows 0 products need reorder
Dashboard: Pending POs shows 1 awaiting delivery
Dashboard: Click on Outstanding navigates to /invoices
Invoices: Stats row shows Total/Paid(green)/Unpaid(red)/Collected/Outstanding
Invoices: Create Invoice dialog with Client select, Due Date, Tax Rate (%)
Invoices: Line Items section with 'Add from product catalog or manually' message
Invoices: Invoice creation works, shows 'Invoice created' toast
Invoices: 'Not Paid' badge visible in RED color on invoice rows
Invoices: Click invoice row opens detail view
Invoices: Detail view shows line items table, subtotal/tax/total
Invoices: 'Pay with Stripe' button visible (green)
Invoices: 'Record Manual Payment' button visible
Invoices: 'Mark as Sent', 'Edit', 'Delete' buttons in Actions panel
Settings: No-Notes Escalation Threshold section visible
Settings: Enable Auto-Escalation toggle works
Settings: Threshold (hours) input visible when enabled
Settings: Escalate To (Senior Member) dropdown visible when enabled
Settings: 'How it works' explanation box with orange border
Settings: Save Threshold Settings button
Settings: Xero Accounting Integration section with 'Not Connected' badge
Settings: Xero Client ID and Client Secret inputs
Settings: Save Xero Settings button
Settings: Stripe Payments section shows 'Configured' badge in GREEN
Products: Page loads with Dell OptiPlex 7090 product (regression)
Purchase Orders: Page loads with PO-1001 (regression)
seed_data_creation: Test invoice INV-20260309-A10F was created during UI testing (may exist in DB). Test Xero credentials were saved (TEST_XERO_CLIENT_ID).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 features all verified working: 1) Invoice Enhancements - CRUD with line items, tax calculation, Stripe payment (returns checkout URL), manual payment recording, payment_status (paid/partial/unpaid), payment history, Paid badge GREEN / Not Paid badge RED. 2) Dashboard Enhanced Stats - 6 operational alert cards (Revenue, Outstanding, No Notes, SLA Breaches, Low Stock, Pending POs) with click navigation to respective pages. 3) Settings - No-Notes Escalation Threshold with enable toggle, hours input, escalate-to dropdown; Xero integration settings storage (MOCKED - no OAuth flow); Stripe 'Configured' badge. Previous features (Products, Purchase Orders) still working.

invoice_enhancements.details: CRUD with line items from product catalog, tax_rate calculation (subtotal+tax=total), Stripe payment returns URL, manual payment recording changes status (unpaid->partial->paid), payment history stored, Paid badge GREEN, Not Paid badge RED

dashboard_enhanced_stats.details: 6 operational cards: Revenue (total_revenue/total_collected), Outstanding (outstanding/unpaid_invoices), No Notes (no_notes_tickets), SLA Breaches (sla_breaches), Low Stock (low_stock_products), Pending POs (pending_purchase_orders). Click navigation to respective pages.

settings_no_notes_threshold.details: GET returns default, PUT saves threshold with enabled=true, threshold_hours, escalate_to. Check-escalation endpoint runs ticket reassignment.

settings_xero.details: Settings storage only - no actual OAuth flow. Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI fields save to DB.

settings_stripe.details: Shows 'Configured' badge in GREEN. Backend uses sk_test_emergent key.

products_regression.details: Dell OptiPlex 7090 product visible, stats cards, Add Product button

purchase_orders_regression.details: PO-1001 visible, stats cards, New Purchase Order button

mocked_integrations.xero: Settings storage only - no OAuth flow implemented
mocked_integrations.stripe: Uses test key (sk_test_emergent) - checkout sessions may not fully complete in live environment
